recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore the literal 2019 wording from FHIR-20328 because it was superseded and refined by later final Security WG decisions; revisit only if a future Provenance-specific issue intentionally changes the ISO 21298 functional/structural distinction.
issue_request: FHIR-20328 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked whether Provenance.agent.type and Provenance.agent.role overlapped too much, rejected constraining the flexible core model, and directed clearer definitions/comments using structural and functional role concepts while acknowledging that some vocabulary overlap can remain.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied through security branch commit d417c5d674 and merge 3845b72a87, which changed source/provenance/provenance-spreadsheet.xml from the older generic wording. That application made agent.type the primary act of participation and added an overlap/ISO 21298 note, while agent.role became functional or structural roles with PRIMAUTH/REVIEWER/VERF examples.
additional_context: Later final Security WG issues FHIR-28184 and FHIR-32453 revisited the same ambiguity and more precisely settled Provenance.agent.type as the functional role/how the agent participated and Provenance.agent.role as structural/security roles. FHIR-32519 and FHIR-32520 cleaned the companion bindings and value sets and are already represented on the combined branch. A 2020 Zulip discussion supports that split. FHIR-53882 is AuditEvent-only and does not reopen Provenance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Provenance is active in source/fhir.ini, and current source/provenance/structuredefinition-Provenance.xml already has agent.type as a functional role with a preferred participation-role-type binding and agent.role as structural/security role text with an example structural-role binding.
